name: SUNSUITE
tagline_en: Booking & operations platform for luxury vacation-rental and spa complexes
audience: Business owners running short-stay rental & spa complexes
summary_he: אתר הזמנות ומערכת ניהול אחת למתחמי נופש וספא: בקשות אונליין, בדיקת זמינות עם זמן ניקיון, אישור בלחיצה, תזמון ניקיון אוטומטי, סנכרון ליומן והודעות לאורחים, כולל מצב שבת אוטומטי.
summary_en: A public booking site plus a single admin panel for vacation-rental & spa complexes: online requests, availability that respects cleaning buffers, one-click approval, automatic cleaning scheduling, Google Calendar sync, guest notifications, and automatic Shabbat mode.
features: Public booking site (hero, per-property showcases, gallery, FAQ, contact)
Overnight and by-the-hour booking in one model
Live availability that includes the required cleaning buffer
Server-side price calculation with extras and extra hours
Digital terms signature captured per booking
Admin overview dashboard with live updates
Bookings queue with filters, search, overlap detection and Excel export
Month calendar with color-coded stays, cleanings and blocks
Automatic cleaning windows sized by guest count
Manual blocks for maintenance or private use
Per-property editor: content, times, cleaning rules, pricing, media
Customers list built automatically from bookings
Reports with charts (by property, type and month) and KPIs
Two-way Google Calendar sync for stays, cleanings and blocks
Automatic email notifications to owner and guests
Automatic Shabbat mode based on real candle-lighting / havdalah times
Motzaei-Shabbat checkout times and weekly commitment-notice logic for spa
highlights: Availability engine treats the post-stay cleaning window as first-class 'busy' time, preventing an entire class of double-bookings.
One-click approval orchestrates cleaning + calendar + email, with best-effort side effects and an idempotent status guard.
Cleaning duration is policy-driven per property (guest-count bands stored as JSON) and applied automatically.
Shabbat mode closes the site automatically using Hebcal times for the property's location, failing open on error.
Realtime admin screens stay in sync via Supabase Postgres change subscriptions.
privacy_note: Demo and docs use example data only (example.com). No real guest data, business identifiers or secrets are included.
